# symbol extraction (classes, methods, functions, arrow functions)

Extracts symbols and their kinds from TypeScript source, including classes, methods, named functions, and arrow-function constants. The test verifies symbol kinds such as "class", "method", and "function" for symbols under the module path "src.billing.app" and requires anchors for each symbol fact.
